_about: What an UNLISTED host tool is, judged by its name (sisi/orchestration.py `classify`). A name is split into words at punctuation and case changes; a phrase matches when its words appear next to each other. `delegation`: the tool starts a worker, so it is never counted as direct work or refused by the meter. `control`: the tool only reads status, waits, cancels, lists, schedules or messages, so it is not counted. A tool named by neither still counts as direct work. Listed tools (canon/orchestration-tools.json) always win.
